name: merged-cleanup
title: Clean up after a merged PR

specification.purpose: For merged PRs in the repository of the current directory, report whether each one's worktree and branches are safe to clean up (check), and clean up those that are (clean): remove the worktree, delete the local branch and origin's branch with a lease on the PR's head, and fast-forward main.

inputs.name: pr
inputs.description: A PR number to check or clean up; 0 means none named.

inputs.name: prs
inputs.description: Up to 5 more PR numbers, comma-separated, digits only; together with pr at most 5. With none named, the latest 3 merged PRs that still have a worktree at their head.

specification.output: Per PR: its number, title, verdict (clean, primary, dirty, locked, ahead, absent, open, closed, error), worktree, branch and a one-line reason; for clean, each step (remove worktree, delete local branch, delete origin branch, fast-forward main) as done, already done, skipped with why, or failed with the error; then a one-line summary, or "Nothing to clean up" when there is none.
outOfScope: Routing turns and the ask-once gate itself: those stay in puddlerouter and @puddleworks/recipes; this request only adds the recipe that uses the gate
Removing puddlerouter's own merged check (_lib/merged.ts) and its tests once the recipe is live (follow-up work in puddlerouter)
Removing worktrees that are dirty, locked, ahead of the PR's head, or not at the head of a merged PR
Any force: no git worktree remove --force, no git branch -D, no plain --force push
Repositories other than the one the current directory is in, and remotes other than origin
Linking, repointing or otherwise changing Orca worktree lineage

examples.answer: After one yes: PR 22: worktree removed, local branch deleted, origin branch deleted, main fast-forwarded (each step shown as done, already done, skipped with why, or failed with the error), then a one-line summary.
After one yes: the same steps for each of the latest 3 merged PRs that still have a worktree at their head, then a one-line summary; or "Nothing to clean up" when there are none.

recipe.whenEmpty: With no PR number, clean considers the latest 3 merged PRs that still have a worktree at their head; when there are none, the recipe says there is nothing to clean up and asks nothing.
